description: This file defines the CallLog class and related functions for managing call logs, including linking contacts and leads, handling call statuses, and triggering call popups within the ERPNext telephony module.

classes.name: CallLog
classes.description: Represents a call log entry with methods for validation, linking contacts/leads, handling call status updates, and triggering UI popups.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Deduplicates dynamic links associated with the call log.

methods.name: before_insert
methods.description: Adds contact and lead links based on the call's phone number before inserting the record.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Triggers call popup after inserting a new call log.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles call status changes, publishing real-time events for missed or ended calls.

methods.name: is_incoming_call
methods.description: Checks if the call is incoming.

methods.name: add_link
methods.description: Adds a link to a contact or lead in the call log.

methods.name: trigger_call_popup
methods.description: Displays a call popup for incoming calls based on scheduled employees and matching numbers.
